name: plots
data_note: layout = 'FDA City plan (emap.pk), registered to the streets': outline read from the FDA City plan published on emap.pk (zoom 19, about 0.25 m), fitted piece by piece to the OpenStreetMap streets (tools/emap_plan.py). plot_number is the number printed in the plot on that plan (read by OCR, checked against the neighbouring plots); plot_no adds the block, and a letter where the plan repeats a number within a block. layout = 'Official block map': outline read from the official FDA City block map and registered to the real streets. layout = 'Generated in the street block': the print does not resolve single plots there, the street block is split into plots of the official size. built and dev_class come from building footprints detected on satellite imagery; plot numbers, status and storeys are sample values.
